Have you ever wondered why modern medicine focuses almost exclusively on chemical intervention, while ignoring the physics of the human body?

In 1934, at the Scripps Ranch in San Diego, a discovery was made that could have changed the course of human history. This is the story of Royal Raymond Rife and the "Mortal Oscillatory Rate."

The Science of Resonance

Every object in the universe has a natural frequency. You’ve seen a soprano shatter a wine glass by hitting a specific note? That’s Resonant Frequency.

Rife applied this exact principle to pathogens. He discovered that every virus, bacterium, and parasite has its own unique frequency. By bombarding these microorganisms with their own specific frequency—what he called the Mortal Oscillatory Rate (MOR)—he could cause them to literally explode, leaving the surrounding healthy tissue completely untouched.

The "Hidden" Clinic of 1934

Under the supervision of a Special Medical Committee from the University of Southern California (USC), 16 terminally ill patients were brought to Rife’s clinic.

The result?
According to historical accounts and the research of Barry Lynes, within 90 days, the committee declared 14 of the patients "clinically cured." The remaining two were reportedly cured after a slight adjustment to the frequency just four weeks later.

Why Haven't You Heard This?

If a 100% success rate for terminal illnesses existed in 1934, why isn't it in every hospital today?

The story takes a dark turn here. Shortly after the success of the clinic:

1. Rife’s labs were mysteriously burned down.

2. The AMA (American Medical Association) allegedly began a campaign to discredit his work.

3. His sophisticated "Universal Microscope"—capable of seeing live viruses—was confiscated or destroyed.

How Can You Use This Today?

While the original Rife technology remains a subject of intense debate and "hidden" history, the core principle remains: Everything is Frequency.

• 432 Hz: Known as the "Natural Frequency of the Universe," used for deep relaxation and alignment.

• 528 Hz: The "Miracle Tone," believed to assist in DNA repair and cellular regeneration.

🌍 Iran’s ambassador to Pakistan: World must not remain silent on US aggression

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador to Pakistan, Reza Amiri-Moghaddam, says the international community must condemn US recklessness and aggression and not remain silent, stressing that Tehran will never accept Washington’s arbitrary interpretation of the truce memorandum.

In a post on X on Saturday, the ambassador said the United States has resumed its aggression against Iran in violation of a truce memorandum and international principles, destroying infrastructure after unilaterally interpreting the agreement contrary to its provisions.
​
The Iranian ambassador stressed that it was obvious the Iranian side would not accept this arbitrary interpretation, which clearly violated the memorandum. Now, he said, the United States has launched a war in violation of the memorandum’s provisions and international principles, destroying infrastructure.
​
Amiri-Moghaddam emphasized that the international community is expected to condemn the United States’ aggressive and reckless actions.
​
He went on to say that after months of mediation by Pakistan, a 14-point memorandum of understanding had been reached, with negotiations scheduled to continue within 60 days.
​
He added that the United States later interpreted the memorandum contrary to its provisions and disrupted parts of the Strait of Hormuz in an attempt to achieve what it could not gain on the battlefield.
​
Iran’s Foreign Ministry, referring to recent US attacks on Iran, stated Saturday that the warmongering US administration has once again betrayed diplomacy, and by disrespecting the mediating body and repeatedly violating the norms of dialogue and understanding, has violated and nullified all components of the June 18 truce memorandum.
​
Full responsibility for the consequences of this breach of commitment lies with the arrogant US regime, it added.
